title: Development and a single-centre temporal validation of a machine learning-based model for early prediction of acute pancreatitis-associated liver injury.
summary: A random-forest model predicted acute-pancreatitis-associated liver injury from admission features; an internal test cohort (n=279) reached AUC 0.972, and a temporally separate validation cohort reached AUC 0.935. It is a single-center retrospective prediction result requiring external validation.
ai_technology: LASSO feature selection and nine ML models; Random Forest was selected for outcome prediction.
